name: papervizagent
description: Scientific figures with upstream PaperVizAgent, separate roles, configurable model providers and Codex subscription fallback. Host-native defaults where tools are available.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Run upstream PaperVizAgent end to end, with configurable roles, modes, retrieval, candidates and critic rounds. Plot mode executes generated Python in a bounded subprocess.

tools.name: infer
tools.description: Run one isolated PaperVizAgent role using its configured provider or Codex fallback. Returns text or an image file and request trace.

tools.name: models
tools.description: Read models and capabilities available through the configured Codex subscription. No inference.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Resolve per-role model routing using optional configuration and verified host capabilities. Does not call a model.

tools.name: web
tools.description: Open this tool's web app: serves the operations page and the MCP endpoint on a free local port, opens a browser there, and returns the URL.

papervizagent_config.title: papervizagent_config
papervizagent_config.description: Optional path to shared PaperVizAgent JSON/YAML model and pipeline configuration.

codex_oauth_token.title: codex_oauth_token
codex_oauth_token.description: Optional externally supplied Codex OAuth access token. Existing Codex sign-in is used when omitted.

codex_account_id.title: codex_account_id
codex_account_id.description: Optional account ID for an external token whose JWT does not contain it.

openai_api_key.title: openai_api_key
openai_api_key.description: Optional OpenAI API key, separate from Codex OAuth.
